set.body:
Implement the compiled derivative, sampling, and primitive accumulation layer.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-422-01: Deterministic information-aware sample selection covers the declared fixed domain and is invariant under equivalent physical grid reparameterizations.
AC-422-02: Fixed-domain gradients and physical SE(3) Jacobians are compiled once using complete Grid affines and validated against finite-difference or analytic references.
AC-422-03: Robust residual, 6x6 Hessian or normal matrix, and six-vector accumulation use primitive reusable storage with no allocation proportional to evaluated samples during a run.
AC-422-04: The small-system solver detects non-finite, singular, and ill-conditioned systems and returns typed failures; damping is explicit and testable.
AC-422-05: JVM and Scala.js kernels agree within registered tolerances on checksums, objective, gradient, Hessian, proposed increments, and failures.
AC-422-06: Dense and stencil evaluation share one objective definition, allowing the stencil result to be checked against a dense reference without a second motion implementation.
set.title: Implement deterministic stencil and robust normal-equation kernels
